name: Raven's Eye
review:
A druid in a misty forest, on 30 lines with mystery symbols and a bonus game featuring Mystery Collect.

Mystery symbols reveal matching icons to help line up wins, and the Mystery Collect bonus gathers values together into one payout. Medium volatility, 1,761x cap, 96.1% RTP. A gentle, atmospheric game for a calm session, with nothing too wild going on.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
